steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: A hypothesis is a testable statement that predicts the outcome of an investigation. | Key Fact: A good hypothesis is specific, measurable and can be tested using data. | Key Fact: The null hypothesis (H₀) states there is no difference, no effect or no relationship — it is the default position. | Key Fact: The alternative hypothesis (H₁) states there is a difference, an effect or a relationship.
